# P08a endpoint allowlist (I09, I11, S14, S15). Checked by TestEndpointInventory.
# Format: <server> <METHOD|ANY> <path> <auth today>
#   server: public (cfg.Addr, also the HEADSCALE_DEBUG_INSECURE_TLS listener),
#           cluster (cfg.Addr of `headscale cluster serve`; every route behind the P08 Host/SNI guard, 421),
#           noise (inside /ts2021), debug (metrics_listen_addr), unix (unix_socket)
#   server (P08b): cluster-v2 (the v2 API of one tailnet runtime behind cluster /api/v2/*),
#           cluster-unix (unix_socket of `headscale cluster serve`: live operator admin)
#   auth:   none | auth (Huma API key / OAuth token) | local-trust (socket file perms)
#           | api-key-tailnet (P08b: global rate limit, then a platform-issued API key picks the tailnet, key and tailnet rate limits)
#           | disabled-404 (cluster: interactive registration refused) | noise-session | noise-handshake | auth-id-secret | oidc-state | ping-id-secret
#           | verify-secret (derp.verify_secret_path, constant-time; none configured = 403 for all)
#           | operator-only (P08 operatorOnly: loopback or metrics_operator_cidrs, never the
#             Tailscale range; replaces tsweb-protected / private-ip / none of P08a)
# Changing this file requires updating evidence/P08a-endpoint-inventory.md and a security review.
cluster ANY /api/v2/* api-key-tailnet
cluster GET / none
